column1: # One line per platform identity: the same app has a bundle id on macOS, a
# package name on Android and a WM class / desktop-file id on Linux, and they
# do not agree. Matching is exact and case-insensitive on the key.
#  - Only apps whose primary use is unambiguous. If a reasonable person would
#    file it differently, it is left out and lands in Uncategorized. The
#    locked rule is "never a confident wrong guess", so absence is the safe
#    answer and the list is deliberately shorter than it could be.
#  - No judgement categories. There is no Productive and no Distracting.
#  - Browsers are Browsing even though people work in them, because the
#    honest answer at the app level is "a browser". Per-site attribution is
#  - IDEs and terminals are Development even when used for writing prose;
#    that is the dominant case and an override fixes the rest.
